name: seated side bend on a chair
description: A gentle seated side bend that works the obliques and loosens the sides of the trunk.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one arm overhead and lean slowly to the opposite side without twisting.
Pause briefly, then return to upright.
Repeat on the other side and keep alternating.
